candidates.snippet: 1847: Birth of Alexander Graham Bell - Alexander Graham Bell was born in Edinburgh, Scotland. 1870: Bell's early work with the deaf - Bell began teaching elocution and speech to the deaf, developing his understanding of sound and acoustics. 1876: Invention of the telephone - Alexander Graham Bell was granted a U.S. patent for the telephone, revolutionizing communication. 1907: Founding of the Aerial Experiment Association - Bell co-founded the Aerial Experiment Association, contributing to early aviation advancements.
